Babs' Bbq Ribs
By: Cheryl M
Published: Wednesday, August 18, 2010 - 9:42pm

Ingredients




2 racks of baby back ribs
1 cup of white sugar
1 cup of white vinegar
1 cup of ketchup
4 cloves of garlic- minced

Preparation

1 Mix the sugar, vinegar, ketchup and garlic together - this will be the sauce for the ribs. 2 Pre-heat the oven to 450. Put the rib strips in a roasting pan. Fill the pan 3/4 of the way up the sides with water. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1.5 hours. Drain the ribs prepare the grill to bbq. 3 Place the ribs on the grill and cover them in the bbq sauce and grill for about 10-15 minutes.
